verified_criteria: Strict SRP enforced between IFileStorageService (storage path resolution, stream opening, and FileMetadata creation) and CsvFileWriter (pure stream formatting without path awareness or row counting).
Complete elimination of legacy IFileManager, FileManager, FileData, RowCount, and Checksum across all layers.

Elimination of user-supplied output directories (OutputFileUri / OutputDirectory) and manual ResolveLocation logic in ExperimentalDataFileWriterStep, MechanicalModelOutputFileWriterStep, and ParametricSweepCsvWriterStep.

Full reuse of existing MelloSilveiraTools infrastructure: Keyed DI for StorageProvider, StoredFileEntity with IRepository, OptimizationJsonOptions.SignificantFigures7, TPL Dataflow pipelines, CommandBaseWithData, and WriteNdjsonAsync streaming.

output_summary: Pre-Execution Strategy QA Gate approved for the 6-phase Agnostic Storage, Pipeline Persistence, Real-Time Progress, and Web API plan. Appended structured Triple Record (Category: Decision) to the Ledger at .agents/soft-tissue-biomechanics/ledger/decisions.md.
justification_for_decisions: The architectural plan in experimental-data-and-storage-api-plan.md strictly adheres to the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP), eliminates redundant path-resolution logic in pipeline writer steps, prevents arbitrary path injection by removing user-supplied output directories, and reuses existing MelloSilveiraTools abstractions (IFileStorageService, CsvFileWriter, StoredFileEntity, TPL Dataflow, CommandBaseWithData, and NDJSON streaming) without reinventing existing components.
